CANDIDATE bd-01M15BM2XK4N6ZRVXHZZAP5E7V: worktree-cursor-grok-strands @ 80af255 (base 29689f4). Files: Scoring.scala, InterviewProfileSuite (new), InterviewPhenomenologySuite (3-arg only), interview/README.md. InterviewSuite untouched. Shared checkout unstaged.

Grains (chief-approved, including mental amendment):
- UNIT (1 per unique sourceUnit): density/word, density/second, purity, probeGain, semanticization, otherEventDrift, redundancy, mentalStateProfile
- SITUATION: anchoring (unique place/time sits), perceptual (situation when present else unit), relationalIntegration, fragmentation (situation graph; mental atoms add no node)
- targetMass stays the raw atom-mass sum; Scaladoc says it is not a measure of remembering. No rate derives from it.

Empty assessments → Missing unit rates (not 0). Public phenomenology is 3-arg only; a private[interview] 2-arg bridge remains so reserved InterviewSuite still compiles. W3 has the 3-arg hunk request (msg-01M15F6MV00R2V7KXS591PW75X).

InterviewProfileSuite laws 1–6 + order invariance + empty Missing: 9/9 JVM, 9/9 JS, 9/9 Native. PhenomenologySuite 7/7 all three. InterviewSuite 23/23 JVM (via the bridge). BirthdayInterviewSuite 16/16. scalafmtCheckAll + compileAll clean at pin-0329c43.
